text: Photography is the art of capturing moments through the lens of a camera. It involves using a camera to record images, often through the use of light, which is captured by the camera and recorded by the imaging sensor or film. By adjusting various aspects of the camera, including the shutter and aperture, photographers can manipulate the exposure and depth of field to achieve specific effects, such as capturing a sharp image with a blurred background or creating a dreamy, artistic effect with a wide-angle shot. With practice and patience, photographers can master their craft and produce stunning images that tell stories and evoke emotions.
